answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7640 Country: Canada Title: At what age does fasting become compulsory? Question: At what age does fasting become compulsory? Answer ID: 7640 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 964/964=M/1429) One is asked to observe fast after being baligh (major/mature) Islamically. If, before 15 year of age, one has the signs of majority like ejaculation etc then he or she will be considered baligh , otherwise after completing 15 years he will be regarded baligh . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
